Emerging from the bottom left of the white square is a black, wavy line that curves upwards and to the right, ending in a series of loops and curves that could be interpreted as hair or a stylized representation of a head. The overall mood of the image is somewhat whimsical and playful due to the abstract nature of the drawing. There are no people, objects, or specific settings depicted beyond the abstract elements.
